astra.history: its own records only (no author hints)

fixed_system.actions: absolute wrist targets (position + finger / palm directions) tracked by differential IK at <= 1 cm and 3 deg per 30 Hz step; four closure fractions per hand at <= 1/30 per step

executors.C1:
C1: corrects achieved tracking errors through the existing segment interface. Wrist: once the commanded segment target has
reached the decision's reference (nominal step < 0.3 cm), the remaining shortfall of the achieved wrist is integrated (gain 0.5,
at most 1.5 cm) and added to the target. Fingers: after closing (lift / hold / transport), each closure command adds
0.5 x (commanded - measured), at most +0.15 (a finger held back by the object is driven further).

C2.observes: robot proprioception, fingertip positions from the robot's kinematics, and the tracked object pose and size (the observations every executor already receives; a state-input prototype, no estimation)
C2.follow_check: during the lift, after every 3-step segment once the wrist has risen >= 1.5 cm: slip if the object's rise is < 0.5 x the wrist's rise since the lift began, or its tilt grew > 10 deg since the end of closing
on_slip: put back: wrist to the grasp height, closures held (9 steps)
open: closures to their approach values (12 steps)
retreat: 3 cm against the palm direction, clear of the object (12 steps)
re-approach: to 1 cm short of the adjusted grasp reference along the palm direction, then onto it (15 steps)

adjust the grasp reference (object frame, at most 1.5 cm per axis): if the thumb tip is above the object's top (height > H - 0.5 cm) or over its opening (radial gap < -0.3 cm): lower by min(1.5, thumb height - (H - 2.0)) cm; if the index / middle tips' mean gap to the wall > 1.0 cm: move along the palm direction by min(1.5, gap - 0.5) cm; if neither: 0.5 cm along the palm direction and 0.5 cm down
lift at 2/3 speed (45 steps), follow check again
smoke_fix: 2026-10-14 smoke test 1: the first version reopened and moved the hand while touching the cup and dragged it 5 cm; retreat / re-approach steps were added and the lift slowed to 2/3 (not 1/2) so two regrasps fit the budget

smoke test 2: lowering 1.5 cm drove the fingertips into the table (the side grasp's little finger is about 1 cm above it); lowering is now capped at the lowest fingertip's clearance minus 0.3 cm, and a blocked adjustment becomes 0.5 cm along the palm direction
C2.budget: at most 2 regrasps and the 400-step budget; a slip after the last regrasp, or a drop, is a failure

budget: 400 control steps from reset (the task horizon) for every executor; then a 40-step evaluation window
state_estimation: not tested here: every executor receives the simulator's tracked object pose (accurate-state prototype)
gate: C1 resolves most failures -> keep C1, no learned contact control yet
C2 resolves most failures -> freeze C2 as System 0, go to the memory stream
commands reach the intended region but C2 repeatedly fails in contact -> train a learned System 0 (time-boxed pilot)
the chosen grasp itself is unsuitable -> improve proposal selection first
accurate-state succeeds, estimated-state fails -> estimation (not testable here)
screening_target: about 90 % success on nominal development cases plus improved recovery on perturbed cases (operational, not a reliability guarantee)
